- [USER] User asked how players adjust their game when playing on grass courts versus clay or hard courts and if there are key differences in playing style.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that players adjust their playing style and technique based on surface:
  - Grass courts require adjustments in movement, footwork, and shot selection due to speed and low bounce.
  - Grass courts favor big servers and strong net games.
  - Clay courts are slower with higher bounce, requiring different footwork and positioning.
  - Hard courts are faster than clay but slower than grass, requiring an aggressive style of play.
- [USER] User found it interesting how players adjust their game based on the surface and asked which players have the most versatile playing styles.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant identified players with versatile playing styles:

  - Roger Federer: multiple Grand Slam titles on all surfaces, adaptable game.
  - Rafael Nadal: adaptable game, successful on clay, hard courts, and grass.
  - Ashleigh Barty: adaptable game, Grand Slam titles on clay and grass.
